{{recipesummary|Appetizer recipes| Yield = 24 bruschette|time=15 minutes|difficulty=2|image=[[Image:FreshMozzarellaBruschetta.jpg|300px]]}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Appetizers|Appetizers]]

'''Bruschette''' are small, open-faced [[Cookbook:Sandwiches|sandwiches]] of tomato and mozzarella cheese. They are delicious, quick and easy to make, and perfect appetizers.

==Ingredients==
*1 long loaf of crusty French [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] 
*3 medium ripe Roma [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
*3 large fresh [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella]] balls
*24 fresh [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] leaves 
*Coarse [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] 
*Black [[Cookbook: Pepper|pepper]]
*Extra virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*[[Cookbook:Oregano|Oregano]]
*[[Cookbook:Vinegar#Balsamic vinegar|Balsamic vinegar]]

==Procedure==
#Cut bread into ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (1.27 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]] on the diagonal.
#Lightly toast bread in the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] on both sides.
#Cut tomatoes into ¼ inch (0.75 cm) slices, and place one on each slice of bread.
#Cut mozzarella balls into ¼ inch (0.75cm) slices and place on top of tomato.
#Slice basil into thin strips and sprinkle on top with the oregano.
#Combine olive oil and balsamic vinegar (to taste) in a small bowl
#Drizzle bruschetta with the mixture and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*An optional re-toasting with toppings on will make the mozzarella melt and be even more delicious.
*Authentic Italian bruschetta begins with rubbing roasted [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] cloves on the toasted bread slices.
